_comment: Friendship with players (#67). levels: from which rapport (-100..100) each level starts, lowest first. cooling: after graceDays calendar days without any contact (talk, a gift, a promise), rapport above warmFloor drops by perDay each calendar day and rapport below coldFloor rises by it, so close friendships need keeping up and grudges fade, but a friend stays a friend. milestones: what the colonist tells the player, privately, the first time they reach a level (for the model, in English; {favourite} is their own odd favourite gift).

milestones.friend: to tell them, briefly and in your own way, that you've come to think of them as a friend.
milestones.good: to tell them something personal you don't tell just anyone: that you have a soft spot for {favourite}.
milestones.close: to tell them, briefly and warmly, that they've become one of the people you trust most here, and to ask them to drop by your workplace some time.
milestones.best: to tell them, in your own way and without fuss, that they are your best friend here and that you'd do anything for them.
